specification_purpose: Fix the operator procedure of the single authorized v6 confirmatory run, so that the session that executes it follows a procedure written before the run rather than one invented while running it. This artifact authorizes no candle read, no evaluation and no second run.

applies_to.evaluation_window_rule: The evaluated window is exactly the first minimum_closed_hourly_candles closed hourly candles at or after the window start, so it ends at the earliest instant the frozen boundary allows. The evaluated window's length does not depend on when the run happens, and the window may not be extended, shortened or re-based at run time.
applies_to.in_scope_configurations_rule: the configuration evaluated for an in-scope asset is the one published in research/v6_selected_configurations_manifest.json by the v6 selection run under the unchanged v1 selection rule; this runbook publishes before that run, so the readiness test requires the selected-configurations manifest to exist and to be hash-bound before the first payload read

code_identity.note: The identity of the run is the composite of the canonical digest of the hashed v1 engine and the canonical digest of the confirmatory execution path. The checkout-dependent ordered digest compute_code_hash() is an environment fact and is never used as an identity.

criteria: net_total_return > 0 at baseline costs (1x) over the confirmatory window
net_total_return > 0 at 2x costs over the confirmatory window
the evaluated parameters are byte-identical to the frozen v6 candidate manifest entry

bounds.membership_rule: a candle is inside a confirmatory window when its close falls strictly after that window's start and before its end, regardless of which asset the candle belongs to; a candle that closes exactly at a window's start is development data

deviation_disclosure.scope: the completed v1 and v2 runs
deviation_disclosure.v6_run_alignment: the v6 run evaluates the BTC trend filter against the index-aligned v6 benchmark dataset

global_rules: the run is a single logical run: it may be resumed, never restarted
every step is fail-closed: a step that cannot prove its precondition stops the run
nothing is repaired: a mismatch is reported, not corrected
every read of the window is counted in holdout_exposed_count
no step contacts a provider except the readiness probe and the single retrieval
the window benchmark series is retrieved with the window, never substituted
the v1 holdout and the v2, v3, v4 and v5 confirmatory windows are never read
the run may not start before the later of the four earlier gates and the v6 window's own earliest end

ordered_steps.action: Confirm, before anything else, that the commit carrying this runbook, the confirmatory protocol and the confirmatory authorization exists, that the authorization is bound to the manifest_hash of this runbook and of the protocol, and that the v6 selection authorization and the v6 selected-configuration manifest exist and are hash-bound. If any of them is missing or disagrees, stop with BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and read nothing.

Run the metadata-only readiness probe: one bounded request per metadata endpoint, the primary host first and the documented failover host second. It fetches no candle and does not increment holdout_exposed_count.

Retrieve the window once: for every in-scope asset and for the benchmark series, in ascending symbol order, one request per asset, closed hourly candles only, with the frozen failover, retry and backoff budget. A read that returns a payload increments holdout_exposed_count.

Persist every retrieved dataset in the canonical hourly CSV of the frozen sha256-canonical-hourly-csv-v1 scheme, together with a record that binds it to the run id, the asset, the window bounds and its content hash. Coverage gaps are recorded; interpolation is forbidden.

Build the window manifest: the window bounds, the retrieval timestamp, the per-asset dataset hashes, the closed-candle counts, the coverage gaps, the exposure events, the readiness record and the window benchmark record.
Re-evaluate the authorization's preconditions with the readiness record, the window manifest and the exposure counter. If a precondition no longer holds, stop; do not repair it.

Evaluate every in-scope asset's frozen configuration over the window with the unchanged v1 evaluation metric and the unchanged cost scenarios. The 576 btc_ema_168 configurations per asset are evaluated, never dropped, re-derived or re-ranked.

Grade every asset with the single preregistered promotion rule of configs/research_v1.json#selection, which governs. No second confirmatory criterion exists in the v6 line and none may be applied. The status vocabulary is not extended: PROVISIONAL_HISTORICAL_SURVIVAL, REJECTED_ON_HOLDOUT, INCONCLUSIVE and CANDIDATE_PENDING_HOLDOUT only. A configuration with zero closed trades is INCONCLUSIVE and never REJECTED_ON_HOLDOUT.
Write the eight authorized output paths in the fixed order, atomically, so that a partial write is never observed.
Run the acceptance checks of this runbook and the verification commands below, and record their exit statuses in the handoff.

endpoints.purpose: spot trading status of the in-scope pairs and of the benchmark pair

readiness_probe.failover_policy: One bounded request to the primary host; on a host-level failure one bounded request to the documented failover host; both statuses are recorded. A retryable status is retried on the active endpoint within the frozen retry budget and backoff. No candle is fetched by the probe.

retrieval.dataset_persistence: the canonical hourly CSV next to a record that binds it to (run_id, asset, window bounds) and to its content hash, under the shard directory of the run

benchmark.alignment_rule: the asset series and the benchmark series are sliced to the same fold window before the frozen engine is called
fail_closed: the benchmark series is shorter than the evaluated window
the benchmark series is not index-aligned with the asset series
benchmark.grid_rule: the 576 btc_ema_168 configurations per asset are evaluated, never dropped, re-derived or re-ranked
benchmark.source_of_truth: the window benchmark series is retrieved with the window and is bound by its own content hash; the development benchmark is never substituted for it

write_order.content: the window bounds, the retrieval timestamp, the per-asset dataset hashes, the closed-candle counts, the coverage gaps, the exposure events, the readiness record and the window benchmark record
the per-asset result rows, one shard file of the confirmatory campaign
the result rows as a single JSONL stream, the projection of the shard
the run identity, the scope, the per-asset outcomes, the exposure count and the completion state
the shard inventory, the record count and the content digests

failure_decision_table.detection: the pre-flight, the readiness probe or the precondition re-check fails
failure_decision_table.response: roll back every artifact the run created, leave holdout_exposed_count at 0 and release the attempt
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: none: the window was never read
failure_decision_table.resumable: the single authorized attempt is still available
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the abort reason in the handoff

failure_decision_table.detection: the run fails after the first dataset has been read
failure_decision_table.response: record the run as EXPOSED_ABORTED, keep the exposure in place, keep the already retrieved and hash-verified datasets, and resume the same run from them; never read the window again
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: the exposure stays: the window is spent
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the confirmatory checkpoint records EXPOSED_ABORTED and the exposure events; no report is produced
failure_decision_table.resumable: yes, as a resume of the same run, bounded by max_retries_on_technical_failure
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the report must state that the window was consumed without a completed evaluation

failure_decision_table.detection: a transport error, a timeout, HTTP 429 or another retryable status
failure_decision_table.response: fail over a host failure to the documented failover host and record both statuses; retry a transient failure on the active endpoint within the frozen retry budget with the frozen backoff, then resume the run
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: a read that returned a payload is counted; a failed request is not
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the verified datasets of the completed assets are kept for the resume
failure_decision_table.resumable: yes, within the frozen retry budget
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the provider statuses with their timestamps in the handoff

failure_decision_table.detection: the recomputed content hash of a persisted dataset differs from the recorded one
failure_decision_table.response: refuse the dataset; do not repair it, do not re-fetch it and do not re-read the window, because a re-read would be a second read of a single-use window
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: the read is counted: the window is spent
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the run is recorded as EXPOSED_ABORTED and the mismatch is reported
failure_decision_table.resumable: no: the resume may only reuse a hash-verified dataset
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the mismatch, the asset and the two digests

failure_decision_table.detection: an in-scope configuration produced zero closed trades on the window
failure_decision_table.response: grade it INCONCLUSIVE; it is never graded REJECTED_ON_HOLDOUT and never graded a failure
failure_decision_table.resumable: not applicable: the run is complete
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the zero-trade outcome in the report

failure_decision_table.detection: the v6 selection run published no candidate for an in-scope asset
failure_decision_table.response: the asset is reported as NO_CANDIDATE and is not evaluated; the scope is not widened to replace it
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: the read is counted for the assets that were evaluated
failure_decision_table.resumable: not applicable: the run is complete
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the asset and its NO_CANDIDATE status in the report

failure_decision_table.detection: two artifacts disagree about what passing the window means
failure_decision_table.response: stop, publish a versioned amendment that reconciles them, and do not apply a second criterion
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: the exposure stays: the window is spent
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the run is recorded as EXPOSED_ABORTED
failure_decision_table.resumable: no: the amendment must precede any re-evaluation
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the two conflicting statements and the amendment

failure_decision_table.detection: the window holds fewer than the minimum closed hourly candles
failure_decision_table.response: stop with BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and read nothing
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: none: the window was never read
failure_decision_table.resumable: yes, at or after the window's earliest possible end
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the observed candle count and the earliest possible end

failure_decision_table.detection: the run would write outside the eight authorized output paths
failure_decision_table.response: stop; a new path requires a new versioned amendment
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: whatever was already read stays counted
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the attempted path in the handoff

checks: the runbook, the confirmatory protocol and the confirmatory authorization are committed and their manifest hashes match the recorded ones

the v6 selection authorization and the v6 selected-configuration manifest exist and are hash-bound, and the selected configuration of every in-scope asset is byte-identical to the frozen manifest entry
the window holds at least the minimum number of closed hourly candles
every retrieved dataset is in the canonical hourly CSV form and its recomputed content hash matches the recorded one
holdout_exposed_count equals the number of reads that returned a payload
the evaluation used the unchanged v1 metric and the unchanged cost scenarios, and no configuration was dropped, re-derived or re-ranked
every in-scope asset has a published outcome and every out-of-scope asset is named with its reason
no artifact outside the eight authorized output paths was written
the v1 holdout and the v2, v3, v4 and v5 confirmatory windows were not read
acceptance_checks.the_output_is_accepted_only_when: every acceptance check passes, the exposure count reconciles with the recorded exposure events, and the report names every in-scope asset with its outcome and every out-of-scope asset with its reason

prohibitions: no re-tuning, re-weighting or re-ranking on the window
no grid extension on the window
no second read of the window
no read of the v1 holdout
no read of the v2, v3, v4 or v5 confirmatory windows
no forward fill of the benchmark series
no interpolation of a missing candle
no substitution of the development benchmark for the window benchmark
no write outside the eight authorized output paths
no repair of a mismatch: a mismatch is reported
no extension of the status vocabulary
no re-run of the confirmatory evaluation
no reporting of a zero-trade configuration as a failure
no hiding of an asset without a candidate
no modification of the v1-v5 frozen artifacts
no read before the later of the four earlier gates and the v6 window's own earliest end

confirmatory_execution_path.rule: the confirmatory execution path is a new directory outside the hashed set; its canonical digest is recorded in the confirmatory authorization

durability.rule: The runbook takes effect when this artifact is committed. No confirmatory-window candle may be read and no evaluation may run before the commit that carries this artifact exists.
durability.note: The commit hash is recorded by the committing session. This artifact is not rewritten after that commit, because its manifest_hash must not change.

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the document body with manifest_hash removed, so the document does not hash itself into a cycle.
